plan.notes: BA in Psychology. Official Monmouth College 'Academic Plan' (sample plan). One Monmouth course credit = 4 credit-hours; credits modeled in Monmouth course credits exactly as printed. The plan places major courses and first-year Core Foundations; remaining credits each term are filled with Core Requirements or general electives per the plan's instructions (those fillers are not modeled). Italics in the source indicate prerequisites exist - see the catalog for chains; not modeled here. 'Or' rows occupying one slot are modeled as single choice slots. Flexible 'take in either term' rows are modeled in the first-listed term and documented. Pages undated (retrieved 2026-10-09); catalog_year labeled 2026-2027. Degree requires 31 course credits; 10 PSYC credits required for the major (modeled at the 1-credit options: PSYC 354/453). PSYC 101 meets the Scientific Inquiry Core requirement; PSYC 201 meets the Quantitative Reasoning in Practice Core requirement. Minimum grade of C- required for major courses per the Requirements page.
